source_evidence: Player exact 'We'll stay at an inn for now, we do also have miregate somewhat nearby. Lets get the same inn and check in correspondents.' Authorizes ordinary lodging and correspondence checks, defers property. Source-pinned archive/history-days-196-199.md D199-COPPER-HART-NIGHT-001 and archive/history-days-205-216.md D208-216-GRAVEN-CATCHUP-001 verify Copper Hart inclusive2gp prior two rooms/three non-V suppers/four horses; new willing innkeeper honors same quote for one night, payment2gp. Existing mail collection addresses D199-MAIL-COPPER-HART-001, D199-MAIL-ROUND-001 and D204-ORSAVEN-INQUIRIES-001: Copper Hart, Exchange, Sabine Okoro/Concord of Factors and established hospice relay, no random availability gate. Cirren independent private response and mentor letter D215 in trackers/csv/cirren/cirren-inventory.csv rows67–68; after109 elapsed days resolve actual independent recipient choices (not recovered historical proof, no game time beyond present check). Before dice Tobin1–5 none,6–13 correspondence only,14–20 open to meeting; mentor1–5 none,6–15 acknowledgment,16–20 invitation. Actual visible secrets batch fe66c6856f01e80a2241ab37be85fc74 Tobin9, mentor2. Ordinary confidential relay has had ample time, establish newly adjudicated second sealed Tobin reply at Sabine and Cirren actual receipt/private reading; Cirren shares only willingness to continue letters and no arranged meeting, not contents/address; no mentor reply held by hospice relay. No additional personal/House mail at inn/Exchange, no implication other offices or Blackthorn have no mail. No new dispatch, privilege, Severin assent, map-room receipt or diplomatic delivery. Ordinary inquiry and booking, no combat or further consequential commitments. D324~19:30 at established Copper Hart Inn, Orsaven. V requested same inn and check correspondence, defers residential purchase because Miregate is accessible separately; neither property inspected, held, bought or reserved. Innkeeper recognizes returning regular guests and voluntarily offers same prior accepted inclusive two-room package2gp/night (D199 and D215), three non-V suppers and all four horses' care/stabling, coach safely stabled; V pays ONE night D324→325 exactly2gp from personal purse2313gp8sp6cp→2311gp8sp6cp. No repeated booking or completed rest yet; Cirren prefers his own room, other room available for V/Mara/Fenar as prior consent-based arrangement without new intimacy. Innkeeper checks actual retained party/House mail, none new at this desk; Mara independently checks existing Exchange correspondence counter, no new personal mail waiting there (no general claim no letters exist elsewhere). Cirren checks Sabine Okoro at Concord of Factors and the existing hospice relay for his D215 letters; independent recipient choices newly resolved after109 elapsed days with genuine Python RNG batch fe66c6856f01e80a2241ab37be85fc74: Tobin face9 (6–13 willing to continue letters) wrote a private second reply returned through existing confidential family channel, available at Sabine's office and actually handed to Cirren on D324; Cirren privately reads and voluntarily shares only that Tobin is willing to keep corresponding but has not agreed to meet. No exact private letter content, recipient address, reconciliation or promise invented. Former mentor face2 (1–5 no reply) no reply available via hospice relay at current check, no death, refusal, or permanent silence inferred. No reply from Severin physically received or confirmed at checked counters; Elara remains Caereth, three-House assent still pending. D290 Edric field-book request directed to Orsaven collection not inn, actual receipt can be checked at map room tomorrow; no fabricated report or receipt. Sealed Crownsunder diplomatic letter and messenger credentials retained, not delivered. No new quest, commission payment, or further spending. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 +1 Shield equipped, old mundane shield unequipped, HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2 boots; Fenar59/59 AC16 fitted breastplate and Insignia of Claws equipped, HD6/6 Rage3/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, natural claws/fangs +9 attack damage1d6+6 (rage+2), greataxe Double-Claw Rend unaffected; Mara, coach and four horses healthy. Rest3/6, rations21/feed28 before paid inn stay; no extra packed supply deduction or rest completed. Crown commission remaining300+1300, Coris300/800, Kestrel custody unchanged, prior loot sold. Await evening choice or actual overnight, next planned correspondence delivery/map-room visit only if V chooses. Dice delegated until stop.
